app.name: Holy Auramaxxxing
app.description: Daily check-ins, small groups and encouragement, grounded in grace.

sos.title: Take a breath
sos.description: You reached out. That took courage. Stay here for a minute.
sos.breathe: Breathe in slowly for four counts, hold for four, and breathe out for six. Do it three times.
sos.verseText: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
sos.prayer: Lord, this moment is hard. Give me strength for the next minute, and show me the way out you promised. Amen.
sos.comingSoon: A breathing timer, Scripture cards and one-tap calls to your partner are coming soon.

landing.title: Freedom grows one day at a time
landing.lede: A grace-centred space where friends check in each day, pray for each other and keep walking together.
landing.graceLine: A slip resets a streak, never a person.

home.title: Today
home.lede: Every morning is a fresh start.
home.verseText: It is because of Yahweh’s loving kindnesses that we are not consumed, because his mercies don’t fail. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness.
home.emptyBody: Your check-in, your streak and your groups will appear on this page.

groups.title: Groups
groups.emptyBody: Soon you’ll be able to start a group or join one from an invite link.

checkIn.title: Check in
checkIn.emptyTitle: Daily check-ins are on the way
checkIn.emptyBody: You’ll answer one question each day. Honest answers always earn the same reward.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.emptyBody: Prayers, nudges and replies from your groups will show up here.

me.title: Me
me.lede: Your profile and progress, visible only to people you choose.
me.emptyBody: You’ll be able to add a photo, a favourite verse and choose who sees what.

settings.title: Settings
settings.lede: Make the app work the way you like.
settings.appearanceBody: System follows your device’s light or dark setting.
settings.languageBody: English is the only language for now. Hindi is planned.

errors.notFoundBody: The link may be old or mistyped. Let’s get you back on track.
errors.errorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
errors.errorBody: Your information is safe. Try again, and if it keeps happening, come back in a few minutes.
